topic: What antenna design considerations minimize signal attenuation in high-noise power line environments for reliable PLC integration?
consensus_response: Antenna design considerations that minimize signal attenuation in high-noise power line environments include impedance matching, EMI shielding, and frequency-selective surfaces (FSS) to filter out noise. Adaptive equalization techniques and orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) can also mitigate non-linear interactions and multipath effects, ensuring reliable PLC integration.
reference_context: PLC faces challenges like signal attenuation, distortion, and security concerns due to power line noise and lack of regulations.
